help.title: Hands on the keyboard
help.p: One decision per page. These keys work whenever you are not typing; single-key shortcuts can be switched off in the account menu.
help.primary: this page's main action (hold it when it changes infrastructure)
help.reject: send the plan back / not accepted (with a reason)
help.verdict: diagnosis: right / partly / wrong / false alarm / again

brief.label: The brief for this item

returned.newPlan: ↩ The agent wrote a plan — back with you
returned.reviewed: ↩ The agent finished its review — back with you
returned.needsAcceptance: ↩ The run finished — a check needs your eyes
ask.failed: pick the next step: a new plan, or a new diagnosis.
ask.not_started: retry the run, or withdraw the approval. A retry runs at once.
ask.replan: have the agent redo the plan as the reviewer asked.
ask.rerun: have the agent diagnose it again.
ask.generate: have the agent write a fix plan from this diagnosis.
ask.resolve.unverified: this run left no verification verdict: confirm for yourself that it is resolved, then mark it.
ask.start_review: send this change to the agent for review. A review only reads.
ask.acceptChange: look at {n} checks, then confirm the change is complete.

sec.rejectedPlan: The plan that was sent back (v{v})
resolve.autoOff: Every check passed. Auto-resolve is off, so it waits for you.
review.note: The review checks that the targets exist, that every command is safe, and what it touches. It is read-only.

toast.sentRca: {ref}: an agent was asked to diagnose it again

rejectChange.placeholder: Why it is rejected (required; it goes to the audit log)
reject.note: The plan is marked rejected and the item returns to you as «plan sent back». When a new plan is made, the agent is given this reason.
close.note: It leaves the queue; new signals from the same source merge into it without alerting; it can be reopened. The detection agent also keeps a note that this item was dismissed.
rejectChange.note: A rejected change ends here; doing it later takes a new request.
story.plan.steps: Show every step of this version
story.none.p: It does not exist, or you may not see it.

world.search: Find a resource: name, type, I# / C#
world.noneAbnormal: Nothing in this view is flagged. That is not the same as healthy: nothing abnormal was found.
world.past: You are looking at {t} UTC ({d} ago): what was not normal is as of that moment; the links are today's relation graph.
node.linksLlm: {n} of the links are inferred by a model (dashed) — advisory only.
legend.llm: Dashed: a relation inferred by a model, advisory
world.failed.p: This does not mean the resources are gone, or that all is well. Last success: {t} UTC.
world.empty.p: Connect a cloud account and run one scan; the map fills in after that.

check.ok: The {view} view matches the data: {n} resources lit, {r} rings, {l} links.
check.bad: The picture does not match the data:

path.none: {a} and {b} are not connected within 8 links.

legend.schematic: Placed by account and region, not a network topology

empty.filtered.big: Nothing of this kind right now
gone.big: {ref} is not waiting on you now

generic.noResource: Not tied to a specific resource.
generic.open: Handle it in the classic page
ask.approve.run: approve this plan. It starts running as soon as you approve.
ask.approve.only: approve this plan. The executor is off right now: approving does not run it.
ask.approve.cannot: read this plan. You cannot approve it right now: {why}
ask.accept.none: look at the result of the run, then accept.
refused.forbidden: your account lacks the permission, or the requester may not approve their own request.
refused.issue_closed: the issue is closed; reopen it first.
refused.state: its current state does not allow this.
refused.no_hash: the plan has no content hash, so an approval has nothing to bind to.
refused.other: the server did not allow it ({code}).
approve.shadow: The access policy is in shadow mode: by the rules this approval would be refused; it goes through and is audited.
toast.approved.only: {ref} approved. The executor is off; it will not run by itself
err.changed: The plan changed while you were reading. It has been reloaded — read it again before approving.
err.partial: The verdict was saved, but the step after it failed: {msg}
sec.failedLoad: This part could not be loaded.
plan.tierNote: «Changes things / read-only» beside each command is classified by code, not stated by the model.
plan.rollback: The rollback, if it goes wrong
plan.rollback.none: This plan declares no rollback steps.
impact.note: The numbers come from the rule relations of the graph, none inferred by a model.
impact.unanchored: This item is not tied to a resource on the graph, so who it touches cannot be worked out.
impact.truncated: Too many relations: these numbers are lower bounds.
checks.none: This plan declares no checks: after the run it comes back here for your acceptance.
cause.none: This item has no diagnosis yet.
ev.grounded: Every cited piece of evidence was found in this diagnosis's own tool results.
ev.ungrounded: Some cited evidence was not found in this diagnosis's own tool results.
peek.summaryOnly: This is the summary stored at diagnosis time; the raw output was not kept.
ran.bind.match: It ran plan v{v} (hash {hash}), the content that was approved.
ran.bind.drift: It ran plan v{v} (hash {hash}); the plan's content changed after it was approved.
ran.bind.noPlan: The plan this run executed could not be loaded.
accept.none: This item has no run waiting for acceptance right now.
accept.rejectNote: Marked not accepted, the item returns to «root cause identified» and this diagnosis is marked disputed.
gate.critic: The reviewing model refuted this diagnosis, so no plan is written automatically; it needs your call.
gate.manual: This diagnosis did not go on to planning by itself; it needs your call.
verdict.ph.falsePositive: Why it is a false alarm (required)
verdict.note.rcaWrong: The diagnosis is marked incorrect and the item returns to you, where you can have it diagnosed again.
verdict.note.falsePositive: Marked a false alarm, the item is dismissed and the detection agent notes that this kind is a false alarm. It can be reopened.
ask.not_started.can: run it now, or withdraw the approval. A retry starts running at once.
ask.not_started.cannot: look at this plan: approved, never started. You cannot retry it right now: {why}
ask.rerun.missing: this item has no diagnosis yet: have the agent diagnose it.
ask.acceptChange.none: look at the result of the run, then confirm the change is complete.
ran.failed.other: Run #{run} failed after {duration}. No step reported a failure.
ran.failed.check: Run #{run} finished its steps in {duration}; a declared check then failed.
ran.failed.rejected: Run #{run} finished in {duration}; it was not accepted.
rollback.ran: The rollback ran {n} steps, all of them succeeded.
rollback.failed: The rollback ran {n} steps and {f} failed — the resource may be left half-changed.
notStarted.executor_disabled: The executor is switched off, so nothing ran this after the approval. Turn the executor on before retrying.
notStarted.generic: The run did not start after the approval: auto-fix is off, or queueing it failed.
approved.line.match: {by} approved this version at {t} UTC (hash {hash}). The content has not changed since.
approved.line.drift: {by} approved this version at {t} UTC. The plan's content changed after that: a run will be refused.
withdraw.note: Withdrawn, the plan is marked rejected and the item returns to you as «plan sent back».
cancel.note: Cancelled, this change ends here; doing it later takes a new request.
replan.note: When it redoes the plan, the agent is given the reason quoted above.
replan.noReason: No reason written by a person came with this rejection.
rerun.note: When it diagnoses again, the agent sees the earlier conclusion and what a person made of it.
sec.readyRca: A diagnosis that passed the gate; nobody has confirmed it
generate.ready: This diagnosis passed the gate for automatic planning, but auto-fix is off, so nobody asked an agent for a plan.
verdict.none: No verdict by a person is on record.
resolve.unverified: This run ended without a verification verdict (the verdict field is empty).
resolve.none: This item has no run on record.
proposed.none: The requester wrote no steps; the reviewing agent will.
clarify.free: The review lists no specific question. Write what should be added:
clarify.note: Your answers go to the reviewing agent as one message; it then reviews again.
plan.diffNote: Against the requester's own steps: {added} added, {modified} changed, {removed} dropped, {unchanged} the same.
plan.none: This change has no implementation plan to approve right now.
approve.reason.ph: Why you approve (required; kept on the change)
approve.reason.label: Reason for approving
approve.reason.need: Write the reason first, then hold to approve.
failChange.note: Marked failed, this change ends as failed; a redo is a new request.
atwork.rca: An agent is diagnosing this item (started {t} ago{by}). No need to ask again before it ends.
atwork.sre: An agent is writing a plan for this item (started {t} ago{by}). No need to ask again before it ends.
atwork.review: An agent is reviewing this change (started {t} ago).
err.inFlight: An agent is already working on this item; wait for it to finish.
feed.none: No agent is working right now.
feed.failed: Agent activity could not be loaded.
story.failed.p: The record of this item could not be loaded. That does not mean it does not exist.
story.rca.needsCall: The second model refuted this diagnosis, so no plan was written by itself; it waits for a person's call.
story.plan.summary.tiers: {label} v{v}　{hash}　{n} steps, {w} of them change things.
story.plan.rejected: This version was sent back by {by}.
story.approve.person: It waits for someone who may approve it.
story.run.notStarted: Approved, but the run did not start.
story.accept.need: This run waits for a person's acceptance: {reason}
story.accept.needPlain: This run waits for a person's acceptance.
story.accept.passed: Every declared check passed; it waits to be marked resolved.
story.accept.noVerdict: The run left no verification verdict; it waits for a person to confirm.
story.dismissed: This item was dismissed. New signals from the same source merge into it without alerting; it can be reopened.
story.change.review.stuck: The review stopped on the {n} questions below; it waits for the requester's answers.
story.change.closed.rejected: This change was rejected and ends here.
story.change.closed.cancelled: This change was cancelled and ends here.
help.story: the item's whole story; on that page: go decide
wait.agentIdle: It is an agent's turn; nothing on record says one has started
story.ask.approve: Approve this plan, or send it back.
story.ask.accept: Look at the checks, then accept the result or turn it down.
story.ask.confirm: Judge whether this diagnosis is right.
story.ask.generate: Have an agent write the fix plan.
story.ask.replan: Have an agent redo the plan that was sent back.
story.ask.failed: The run failed: decide between a new plan and a new diagnosis.
story.ask.not_started: Approved, but the run never started: retry it, or withdraw the approval.
story.ask.start_review: Hand this change request to an agent for review.
story.ask.generic: Look at it and decide the next step.
story.scopeMoved: The account scope is now “{name}”: this item belongs to that account.
story.found.seen: The same signal was seen {n} times; all are merged into this item.
story.rca.belowGate: The model's own confidence, {conf}, is below the auto-fix gate of {gate}, so no plan was written by itself; it waits for a person's call.
story.plan.unclear: The code cannot classify, or refuses, the command of {u} more.
story.plan.count: This item has had {n} plans; this is the newest.
story.run.checking: Approved; checking whether the run has started.
story.run.started: The run started at {t} UTC and has not ended.
story.change.review.stuckPlain: The review needs clarification; it waits for the requester's answer.
plan.basis.older: This plan was written from an earlier diagnosis, not the current one.
plan.basis.rewritten: This plan's record was created at {t} UTC, before the diagnosis it is based on: it was rewritten since, and when is not on record.
live.honest: This lists only state the server can check. An agent's steps are not streamed: its result appears when it ends.
live.failed.p: That does not mean no agent is at work.
live.gone.big: This lane is no longer listed
live.gone.p: It ended, or it is more than a day old.
live.moved: It has ended. This is what it left behind.
live.basis.requested: On the server's record: {who} asked for it, and this process is still on it.
live.basis.run: On the server's record: a run row is pending or running.
live.basis.status: Known from the item's status; the back end records nothing finer.
live.basis.event: Known from the timeline: the run started and no end is on record.
live.basis.schedule: On the server's record: a run of this schedule is in progress.
live.basis.build: On the server's record: this graph build is in progress.
live.overdue: It has outlived its own time limit and may be stuck.
live.plan.none: The plan it is running was not found.
live.noSteps.run: The executor writes each step's result only when the run ends, so how far it has got cannot be seen yet.
live.noSteps.agent: Until the agent is done the back end records none of its steps. When it ends, the result appears under “Ended in the last day”.
live.noSteps.review: The review leaves no record until it ends. It is read-only: it changes nothing.
live.result.none: This run's record was not found.
live.result.newerRca: The item has a newer diagnosis since; this is the newest one.
live.group.stalled: Stalled: no agent is on it
live.basis.stopped: The item's status still says “investigating”, but its last diagnosis ended on the timeline and left no result. No agent is on it now.
live.stopped.next: It is on nobody's list. Its story page has the whole record; to move it, somebody must rerun the diagnosis or dismiss it (on the classic page, for now).
story.rca.stopped: The last diagnosis ended at {t} UTC and left no result; the status stayed “investigating”, and no agent is on it now.
story.rca.stopped.unknown: The last diagnosis ended and left no result; the status stayed “investigating”, and no agent is on it now.
